  WHY: Both reviewers report that the empty iteration fails the `gh secret list` check and increments `failed_count`, although Qwen disputes that leading whitespace produces an empty iteration.

- README.md:60-66 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]

- agents.md:2532-2538 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]

- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md:46-52 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Checklist step 2 still tells users to add secrets manually.
  WHY: This conflicts with the reported automatic secret propagation workflow.
- scripts/propagate_consumer_secrets.sh:95-99 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The empty-target check removes only literal spaces, so whitespace-only input containing tabs or newlines is treated as an explicit target list.
  WHY: Word splitting produces no targets, allowing the script to exit successfully without processing consumers or backfilling the registry.
